name: valve_prison_teleport_charge
note: Nova Prospekt's teleporter charge under the floor (d2_prison_08, the teleport room): an open slot in the floor 128 wide, 552 long and 128 deep running from the far wall to the teleporter's steps, with six Combine dials (combine_tptimer, every 92) on its bottom, seven green glows (env_sprite) 23 under the rim and six laser beams (env_beam, green, a little noisy) from glow to glow, three green lamps and three click sounds; players walk over it on an invisible lid 8 thick (kept: two layers marked lid and a func_clip_vphysics). As the teleporter charges, each dial runs its 30 s fill and at 28 s lights its beam to the next glow: the line of light grows from the far wall to the teleporter in six steps about 26 s apart, done when the charge is (key 'clock': about 160 s from the start, the hum stepping 50 to 165). Valve's flags start it full (beams and glows on, lamps lit) and the off relay empties it. The teleporter, its lift and route (in 'route', the clock's stops), its lightning and Alyx's lines are not in the piece (outside). Wiring below in prefabs.md.

clock.what: start (Valve: logic_first_attack_sounds_3, fired when both turrets are set down)
piece: hum Volume 10 @2.1 (a known bug: Volume starts a sound the entity cannot stop)
story: teleport_charge_beam_1 TurnOn @3 and teleport_sprite_2 ShowSprite @3 (on the lift)
crashes, shakes, Alyx, the first wave @10

then: dial 1 full, its beam, sprite, lamp and click @28 (t 32.0)
dial 2 full, its beam, sprite and click @28 (t 56.7)
dial 3 full, its beam, sprite, lamp and click @28 (t 82.7)
dial 4 full, its beam, sprite and click @28 (t 108.7)
dial 5 full, its beam, sprite and click @28 (t 134.7)
dial 6 full, its beam, sprite, lamp and click @28 (t 160.0)
